notes: This is a school program, not a job.
name: Capital Region Technical Early College (CRTEC)
org: Clinton County RESA, Eaton RESA and Ingham ISD
city: Lansing area, MI (Clinton, Eaton and Ingham counties)
what_you_do: Start in 11th grade and finish in 13th grade. Earn college credit toward a degree or certifications and get career-related experience.
who_can_apply: Students who attend a public school full time in Clinton, Eaton or Ingham County. You can take courses offered across the region.
deadline_text: Application steps and deadlines are not posted on the page. Contact a coordinator.
how_to_apply: Contact a coordinator: Pam Kunkel-Chappell at Ingham ISD, 517.244.1329. Others are listed on the site for Clinton and Eaton counties.
